title: Xbox launches Xbox Labs to test what's next 🧪
subject: xbox
description:
What should Xbox Labs build first? 👇

Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced Xbox Labs on October 13, 2026: a small team of game makers, engineers and scientists exploring new tech like games running in browsers and on Apple Silicon. The labs.xbox.com site only has an email signup so far.

Sources: Pure Xbox (Oct 13, 2026), Xbox Wire 'Introducing Xbox Labs' via Final Weapon (Oct 13, 2026)

scenes.text: Xbox just created a new division called Xbox Labs.
CEO Asha Sharma announced it to her team on October 13.
It's a small team of game makers, engineers and scientists, turning new tech into things people can play.
Sharma pointed to old games rebuilt for new hardware, and Windows games running on Apple Silicon or in a browser.
She says people spend over 72 billion hours a year playing Xbox games.
For now, its website, labs.xbox.com, is just an email signup.
